_comment: Legacy Jekyll URLs that are DEAD on production → their home on this site. Consumed by scripts/prerender-meta.mjs, which emits a 200 redirect stub at each path. Keys are exact pathnames, no trailing slash; a key ending in .html is emitted as that literal file. Every key was confirmed to 404 on www.alexmaclean.ca before being added — a Wayback hit alone is NOT sufficient, see _projectSites.
_projectSitesNote: Live GitHub Pages project sites from separate repos, mounted under this domain at /<repo>/. They are NOT dead legacy URLs. A stub here would deploy a file over a working demo, so the build throws if any redirect key collides with this list.
